_readme: Project defaults for StoryAura Land settings. The server reads this file at startup. A value saved in the database (admin page > Rules, or the app_settings table) always wins over this file, and changes here need a deploy. Delete a line to fall back to the built-in default. See CustomerRules.md for what each setting means.
_about_free_period_days: How many days a new account can use the app for free.
_about_free_story_limit: AI-written stories a free account can create during the free period.
_about_admin_page_path: Secret address of the owner admin page: dansprout.com/<this word>. /admin shows "not found" while this is set. Empty = use /admin.
_about_free_library_story_limit: Ready-made library stories a free account can start during the free period (separate from the AI limit).
_about_free_learner_limit: How many learners (children) a free account can have.
_about_learner_limit_individual: Learners allowed on the paid Individual plan.
_about_learner_limit_family: Learners allowed on the paid Family plan.
_about_learner_limit_classroom: Learners allowed on the paid Classroom plan.
_about_paid_story_limit_monthly: AI stories per month on paid plans. 0 = unlimited.
_about_pricing_coming_soon: Pricing page: "default" follows the server switch, "on" shows Coming soon, "off" shows real plans.
_about_plan_exempt_emails: Emails that are never limited, e.g. ["friend@example.com"]. The owner is always never-limited.
_about_illustrations_enabled: "on" makes a cover picture for each AI story, "off" turns pictures off (saves money).
_about_image_style: Picture look: bright_cartoon, soft_pastel, flat_vector or storybook_painting.
_about_image_model: OpenAI model that draws the pictures.
_about_image_quality: Picture quality: low (cheapest), medium or high.
_about_image_cost_usd: Price per picture in USD for the cost report. 0 = estimate automatically.
_about_narration_voice: Read-aloud voice: marin, cedar, coral, nova or shimmer. Applies to audio made from now on.
_about_ai_monthly_limit: AI actions one account can use per month (a safety cap on cost).
_about_story_requests_per_15min: Story requests allowed across the whole site every 15 minutes (protects against floods).
_about_roster_import_max: Maximum learners in one classroom CSV import.
